g.text: ✓ The full logo, with clear space around it
✓ The badge: where to find us, when there is no QR code
✓ The name, where the sentence is too long
✓ The mark as an avatar: the letter centred, the underline below
✗ The address set as a logo (logo font, square dot, underline)
✗ The address joined to the sentence
✗ A full stop on the name or the mark
✗ Full colour on a busy or mid-tone background
